errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва дела в проценти, вариращ между 0,44% и 3,72%.
errors.evidence: The description states the range of the vertical axis is between 0.44% and 3.72%. This is incorrect; it describes the range of data values, not the axis range, which is 0 to 4. Furthermore, the minimum data value is 0.38, not 0.44.

errors.text_span: Всяка стълбовидна диаграма има приблизителна стойност, отбелязана в долната част на стълба.
errors.evidence: The numerical values are marked above each bar, not at the bottom. Also, the values are exact, not approximate.

errors.text_span: Най-ниският стълб съответства на 2016 г., с показател 0,44% за износ
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The lowest bar corresponds to the year 2017 with a value of 0.38 for imports ('внос'), not 2016. The value 0.44% in 2016 corresponds to imports, not exports.
The description does not mention the range of the y-axis (0 to 4) or the intervals of its major gridlines (every 0.5 units).
The description fails to mention that the bars are grouped by year, which is a key structural element of the chart.
The text uses the phrase "Всяка стълбовидна диаграма" (Each bar chart) when it should refer to "Всеки стълб" (Each bar).
